scientific_integrity: Underlying log-linear replicator and dominance inversion are established prior work. New claim concerns the sharp double-exponential law, its positive orbit-dependent amplitude, and universal cross-player decay ratio. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Both players have two actions and strictly positive payoff differences in both opponent columns; every initial action probability is strictly interior. No noisy, finite-precision, or weak-dominance case is proved.
title: Sharp double-exponential elimination in strictly dominant two-action log-evidence games
